title: Charles V signs the New Laws for the Indies
summary: Charles V issued the New Laws in Barcelona, banning the enslavement of indigenous Americans and limiting the encomienda labour system.
reason: Reports by Bartolome de las Casas and others about the brutal treatment and collapse of native populations moved the crown to act.
significance: They were among the first laws of a colonial power meant to protect colonized people, though settler revolts forced their weakening.
